products.title: Terracotta Hand-Painted Lotus Choker & Jhumka Set
products.description: Intricately hand-sculpted river clay medallion with hand-painted lotus petals using natural waterproof pigments, suspended on rich crimson resham silk thread with adjustable bead slider.
products.materials: River Terracotta Clay, Resham Silk Thread, Brass Beads

products.title: Dual-Tone Royal Filigree Brass Kada & Bangle
products.description: Hand-hammered pure brass open kada inspired by traditional Zamindari motifs. Coated with micro-lacquer to prevent tarnishing. Fully adjustable for all wrist sizes.
products.materials: Pure Beaten Brass, Antique Lacquer Polish

products.title: Terracotta Sunburst Temple Jhumkas
products.description: Lightweight terracotta clay jhumkas fired at high temperature for maximum durability, accented with emerald green bead clusters and 925 sterling silver plated hypoallergenic ear studs.
products.materials: Baked Terracotta, Hypoallergenic Posts, Glass Seed Beads

products.title: Men's Matte Onyx & Raw Lava Stone Healing Bracelet
products.description: 8mm natural matte black onyx and genuine porous lava rock beads strung on heavy-duty silicone stretch cord, finished with an engraved brass lionhead bead.
products.materials: Natural Matte Onyx, Volcanic Lava Stone, Antique Brass

products.title: Artisan Melodious Ghungroo Double-Strand Payal
products.description: Double-layered German silver anklet handcrafted with soft musical ghungroo bells that make an enchanting subtle chime with every step. S-hook secure closure.
products.materials: German Silver Alloy, Musical Brass Ghungroos

products.title: Baby's Gentle Nazariya Soft Silver Bell Anklet Pair
products.description: Crafted with baby-safe smooth edges and protective black glass nazariya beads with soft-tinkle tiny silver bells. Anti-allergic, non-toxic, and adjustable for newborn to 2-year-olds.
products.materials: Lead-Free Silver Finish, Smooth Protective Glass Beads

products.title: Handwoven Mustard & Indigo Silk Thread Bangle Duo
products.description: Pair of bangles wrapped in premium micro-sheen raw silk threads with delicate gold zari borders and crystal stones. Comfortable velvet lining inside.
products.materials: Pure Silk Thread, Acrylic Core, Zari Embroidery

products.title: Men's Braided Leather & Hammered Copper Bar Cuff
products.description: Genuine full-grain braided leather band paired with an artisan hand-stamped solid copper plate. Magnetic slide-lock clasp in stainless steel.
products.materials: Top-Grain Leather, Solid Copper, 316L Stainless Steel

products.title: Boho Cowrie Shell & Braided Hemp Summer Anklet
products.description: Natural hand-selected cowrie shells woven into organic wax-coated hemp cord with turquoise accent beads. Waterproof and beach-ready.
products.materials: Natural Sea Cowrie Shells, Waterproof Hemp Cord, Turquoise Beads

products.title: Baby's Hand-Carved Wooden & Silver Nazariya Bracelet
products.description: Smooth organic neem wood beads alternating with soft silver-finish protection charms. Soft cotton cord with sliding knot for easy growing fit.
products.materials: Medicinal Neem Wood, Smooth Beads, Soft Cotton Thread
